epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幾位朋友邀請保羅參加在學校天台舉行的秘密派對。當保羅因一場惡作劇而意外身亡時,這群朋友決定隱瞞此事,並承諾會永遠保密。保羅誓要復仇,並變成厲鬼把他們嚇翻,讓他們為自己的行為負責。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,富甲一方的康氏慘遭滅門,唯一的目擊證人—家中的幼女—在親眼目睹全家被殺後離奇失蹤。幾十年間,位於青木巷的廢棄康宅充斥著靈異驚悚的氣氛。隨著真相逐漸揭露,這個恐怖的疑團交織著復仇與死亡的動機。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開. . .
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect.  However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙胞胎兄妹在偏遠旅館渡過恐怖的一夜,為調查其父親在兩人出生前失蹤的真相。當他們深入調查後,旅館的暗黑秘密把他們困於地獄迷宮中,兄妹二人定要在黎明前逃離險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A pair of fraternal twins spend a terrifying night in a remote inn to investigate the last known whereabouts of their father who mysteriously disappeared the night they were born. As they dive deeper, the propertys dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Based on true events, a young scientist who specialises in the study of aliens and extraterrestrials sets out to uncover the mystery behind a series of strange occurrences in Kerala.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: As a young mother grapples with her daughters mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 集賢武館主人平伯被日高手谷嵐所殺,其子鐵娃入山投靠大舌頭,與大之女紅蝴蝶相處甚歡。時穀之子剛自日學成歸來,挑撥大熊與鐵。後熊與剛決戰死於暗算;鐵與紅得悉,下山報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the “sick people of Asia” and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年,光緒帝親政后,開始着手維新變法,惜改革觸犯了想保全自身富貴功名的官僚的阻擾。支持皇帝變法的康有為性格軟弱,堅持變法的譚嗣同難免浮躁,光緒深知自己的處境危險,於是企圖利用袁世凱去對付握有兵權的榮祿。但在關鍵時刻,袁世凱見風使舵卻向榮祿告了密,出賣了光緒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu’s enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一位功夫師傅與三位門徒被惡霸欺淩,師徒俱敗於他拳下。三徒悲憤填膺,分別尋師學藝。半年後,惡霸壽辰之日,三徒連袂回歸,誓要與惡霸一較高下!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master’s birthday.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事背景為一幢女子公寓,房東陳太太痛恨男人,嚴禁男性進入,不幸,女房客卻多靠男性而活;歌女尤淑文由台北飛到香港,找尋失蹤的妹妹;尤經作曲家王德生介紹到居所樓上之女子公寓居住...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A Taiwanese singer comes to Hong Kong in search for her missing younger sister, who had arrived in Hong Kong to be discovered as a nightclub singer. She finds lodging at an apartment for women run by a man-hating landlady, Mrs Chan. However, Mrs Chan cannot confine the young ladies’ youthful vitality within the apartment.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片講述洪熙官被投靠清廷之武林敗類高進忠追殺,身受重傷,市井英雄朱才、陳阿全、梁天寶安排洪藏身於豆腐店中,並為他買藥治傷。高進忠探得洪藏身之處,暗囑手下廣佈眼線,以便將洪一舉成擒...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong’s enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家子卓明不顧父親反對,與歌女雪玲結婚,並因此與家庭斷絕關係。婚後,雪玲懷孕,卓明因過度勞累導致視力衰退。為維持家計,雪玲重操舊業登台演唱,而卓明不願拖累妻子,選擇悄然離開。在友人鼓勵下,雪玲再次公開獻唱,卓明深受感動,最終與妻兒重逢。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ming marries singer Ling, defying his wealthy father and severing family ties. When Ling becomes pregnant, Ming’s overwork causes him to lose his sight. To support their home, Ling returns to the stage but Ming leaves to avoid becoming a burden. Encouraged by a friend, Ling performs again, and her song moves Ming to reunite with his wife and child.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛,得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄,從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品,更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The young Wong Fei Hung and his friend Wang Yin Lin offend the young master of another rival school and the expert they hire, causing both martial arts schools to fight against each other. This is Director Liu Chia Liang’s masterpiece and one of the top ten highest grossing movies in 1981.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展,兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀,江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角,老父回來見三位女兒成就,開心不已。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣東十虎之首的鐵橋三為人景仰,擁有徒弟無數。當時達官貴人都以吸食鴉片為時尚,而鐵橋三亦隨俗吸食,身子因此漸受毒害。後來,鐵橋三更被煙館主人擊敗,幸得徒弟捨身相救,他才不致喪命。於是,鐵橋三決心戒掉鴉片,重新振作。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house’s owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠女花碧蓮愛上鄰村的駱宏勛,其父花振芳去說親,卻遭駱母拒絕。碧蓮深心不忿,找上駱家,把宏勛打倒來消氣。後碧蓮為救人而得罪賭棍萬三句,萬率眾圍殺碧蓮,幸宏勛及時趕來相救。萬之主人王倫知悉一切後,重金收買知府,將宏勛打下冤獄。碧蓮往探監,見宏勛奄奄一息,遂隻身闖進王倫練武場,大戰眾強徒,並取下王倫助手首級。翌日,碧蓮把血淋淋的人頭掛在竹竿上,到市上去叫賣,結果驚動官差,被捉進衙門...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards’ heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷,滿腹經綸,卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻,夏氏貪圖富貴,強逼如龍退婚;如龍不肯,夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜,將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍,與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京,更以如龍之名赴考,一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡,乃命相國為媒,招為駙馬。洞房之夕,鳳簫向公主言明真相,並說服公主,安排一條妙計…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片改編自七十年代知名小說家江之南的作品。故事描述,劉永被掠去財物,為生計打劫,開罪了歐陽幫,但幫主欣賞劉膽色,交上朋友來,後保鏢李麗麗對劉有好感,卻惹黑旗門胡妒忌…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Liu serves his triad society loyally and tries to live a respectable life, but over time his good intentions lead him to an all-out gang war with a startling conclusion.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一名強盜和一位居無定所的賭徒合作以賭賺錢。一天,他們成功從叛國軍閥屋裡偷取一大筆金錢,途中卻遇上革命戰士,並希望他們能資助革命叛軍計劃。二人是否會用偷來的財富協助革命戰士?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord’s home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists’ cause with the stolen money?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍,啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍,而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是,此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技,二人皆為深不可測的武林高手!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 幽默風趣的愛情喜劇,三個年青醫生常開道、史瑞科、蕭而可,被安排追求院長的三個女兒靈珍、靈珊、靈玲。三人以「包、剪、搥」來決定追求對象,他們的追女橋段層出不窮,用盡英雄救美、苦肉計、死纏爛打等愛情藥方,卻全部失靈,烏龍百出...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 由楚原改編古龍小說及執導。偽君子天公子誘發蕭十一郎與連城璧決鬥,製造武林大亂,欲登上武林盟主之位。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the Deer Sword. Lians wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao’s home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife’s faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將;一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞,蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災,蛇王子答應率蛇作法,引水入寨,但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years.  All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一次驅鬼時,青年術士魯興與友人因功力太差被女鬼戲弄險告喪命,幸得連大師施法幫助,才將女鬼驅逐。於是二人馬上拜他為師。友人意外地被日本忍者所殺,魯興決定要學習絕世茅術,與大師一起對付殘暴的忍者,因而引發終極亂鬥!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本,意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河,卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽?二人的戀情又會否無疾而終?
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus’ Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 智明在北少林習武,司馬燕則在南少林習武,兩人分別為報殺父之仇而合力行刺貪官,引發激戰連場!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers’ death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事,講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘,二人一見鍾情,結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨,屢遭迫害,二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後,聞悉生母被壓華山,悲憤欲絕,藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神,劈山救母。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Lindas tragic suicide.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 獨臂刀方剛與妻子二人息隱歸田,但當方剛的妻子被擄走,他唯有被迫重出江湖對付武林惡黨「八大刀王」,以救回妻子。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 年輕俊秀,生於名門望族的日籍華人林保,自幼失去父母,與大學好友川村感情深厚。二人都對美少女琉璃子心存愛慕,但川村自憐身世,不敢與林保爭奪,林保順利娶得琉璃子為妻。林保出國公幹期間,川村和琉璃子耐不住寂寞,有了姦情。不久之後,林保竟在一次滑雪中意外身亡...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一個身手不凡的獨行客與一隊英姿颯爽的娘子軍,合力對抗一羣張牙舞爪的土匪,成功阻止皇帝的陵墓被盜。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor’s tomb.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 任職推銷員的余小寶失戀後,遇上剛剛跟男友分手的富家女金金。二人同病相憐,很快便墜入愛河並閃電結婚,開展甜蜜的生活。可惜,此時金金卻發現自己懷上了前男友的骨肉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend’s baby...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楚留香與八王爺設下計謀,佯裝行刺失敗,趁機潛入「幽靈山莊」作臥底,意圖將這座罪惡巢穴一舉殲滅。山莊內聚集了江湖上惡貫滿盈的亡命之徒,且傳言時有鬼魅出沒。楚留香在查探過程中,逐漸陷入一連串懸疑詭祕的事件之中。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》,內容描述民國初年,富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙,同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑,更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助,才從大帥手中救回愛人。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General’s henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述以「反清復明」為號召的天地會,恐被清廷一網打盡,遂將會員名冊分成兩份,送往機密地點。天地會中人紅娘子遇上剛直的失業捕快阿雲,邀其協助把名冊送到朱標的武館去,期間遇到聰敏的棺材舖夥計阿寸,發生連串笑料。及後紅被原為清廷走狗的朱所殺,雲為代紅執行任務,終亦重傷身亡。最後任務便落在阿寸身上,寸與朱展開連番追逐,最後為寸所殺,而寸亦身陷劣境之中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述以「反清復明」為號召的天地會,恐被清廷一網打盡,遂將會員名冊分成兩份,送往機密地點。天地會中人紅娘子遇上剛直的失業捕快阿雲,邀其協助把名冊送到朱標的武館去,期間遇到聰敏的棺材舖夥計阿寸,發生連串笑料。及後紅被原為清廷走狗的朱所殺,雲為代紅執行任務,終亦重傷身亡。最後任務便落在阿寸身上,寸與朱展開連番追逐,最後為寸所殺,而寸亦身陷劣境之中...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because its also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 方剛的父親為救神風大俠齊如峰而死,齊如峰感念救命之恩,收留方剛入金刀門。方剛卻飽受師兄等人的歧視,於是決定遠走他鄉。齊如峰的獨女與方剛決戰時,竟用刀斬斷其右臂,方剛卻因此練成獨臂刀法,最終更挺身而出救助齊如峰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His masters daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述清帝雍正為了鞏固統治地位,組織了一暗殺集團「血滴子」,為他殺害異見分子。時有一清廷侍衛統領韓天德者,因不值雍正所為而遭殺害,幸其妻容秋燕適不在家,幸免於難,容悲憤莫名,獨闖「血滴子」統領金罡風家,為夫報仇,終行刺失敗而回。後得棄暗投明之前「血滴子」成員馬騰及其師弟王俊相助,合三人之力終將金罡風殺死,替夫報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon’s pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

epg.programme_title_en: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片算是金庸《倚天屠龍記》之外傳。由爾冬升飾張無忌、狄龍飾蒙古戰士、萬梓良飾宋青書及鍾楚紅飾蒙古公主。故事講述張無忌取回倚天劍、屠龍刀,供放在明教總壇,並將九陽神功秘笈刻於三重峰密室之中,由已皈依佛門的金毛獅王監守,原經交回少林...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the yin and yang combination to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 濟公與修道成仙的呂洞賓鬥智鬥法,二人使出渾身解數,不論是笑聲、法力、風流韻事,甚至乎兵器,雙方都不惜一切對決到底!
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 桂武和甘聯珠夫婦共闖江湖、報恩仇,得女俠紅姑之助,技藝大進,博得鴛鴦劍俠美名;桂甘今受紅姑所托,將殺人利器「鳳琴」送往家中;誰料途經飛虎寨,不慎以「鳳琴」射傷少寨主,當夜琴亦為神偷盜去...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 晉靈公寵信奸佞屠岸賈,時邊關告急,相國趙盾啟奏,反被屠岸賈挑撥,下令斬殺趙家三百餘口。幸程嬰抱莊姬之子趙武出走。屠下令殺全國男嬰以斷後患,程不惜以己子代替。趙長大,程以“雪冤圖告之,殺一家三百口仇人乃屠岸賈,更安排他與母親相認......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 劇情描述楊過逃離全真教,誤打誤撞與小龍女相遇。二人在古墓生活,本為融洽;後小龍女為師姐李莫愁所傷,更遭尹志平迷姦。小龍女誤以為失身於楊過,遂提婚議,楊過不知就裡加以婉拒,小龍女悲憤離開古墓。楊過四出訪尋,終與小龍女重逢;惟重提婚事,卻為黃蓉勸阻。小龍女為不讓師徒戀損楊過聲譽,悄然出走...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him—only for her to refuse his proposal.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 青年歌手趙克仁被夜總會老闆委托,到日本尋找他的女兒秋婷。克仁在日本遇到了少女花子、表妹荔萍、女歌手蘇珊、以及冒認是秋婷的女子。克仁愛上了蘇珊。當老闆親自去日本,便認出了蘇珊就是他的女兒秋婷...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Betty Ting plays Susan, a young woman hiding from her father by being a nightclub singer in Japan. Pop singer Chao Ke-jen (Lin Chong) gets permission from his boss to visit Japan, with the condition that he finds the bosss daughter. Boy finds girl, boy falls in love. But will the father approve?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 俠盜金毛獅武功高強,經常劫富濟貧。一夜他遭黑幫突襲,幸遇太湖七獅,把他送往神醫處救治。神醫攜金毛獅赴回魂谷採藥治傷,卻屢遭黑幫追殺,險象環生...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述三女意外獲得大筆財產,必須遠赴日本領取,途中遇上三位男人,也想分一杯羹。正當大家各懷鬼胎,彼此攻擊、賄賂甚至出賣對方,企圖獨佔鉅款時,殊不知更驚悚的遭遇正嚴陣以待。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋朝康王被困於金營巨宅,四周被武林高手嚴密看守。兩名身懷絕技的義士必須克服重重困難,完成看似不可能的任務,設法救出康王。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 影后李菁的代表作,蕭湘反串文必正,傾慕官府小姐霍定金,賣身混入霍家,二人私定終身,必正被陷害入獄,定金設法營救...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family’s young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo’s stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 宋太祖趙匡胤之弟光義恃建國有功,囂張跋扈,逼殺南唐後主李煜,李之舊部李浪矢誓報仇。太傅陳搏因欲修煉成仙,必先得皇帝封誥,故與光義妥協,助其奪取帝位,事成後由光義祭天封為華山神仙。陳搏帶光義夜闖禁宮,弒兄自立,並殺死李浪等心腹大患...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自俠義小說《七俠五義》,人物繁多,情節多變,難得張徹處理得有條不紊,角色性格分明。故事講述襄陽王在王府中,建造的沖霄樓機關密佈,又廣招花蝴蝶花沖、神手大聖鄧車和小諸葛沈仲元等江湖俠士加盟,伺機造反。包公得悉襄陽王叛跡,乃命門生顏春敏前往調查。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自俠義小說《七俠五義》,人物繁多,情節多變,難得張徹處理得有條不紊,角色性格分明。故事講述襄陽王在王府中,建造的沖霄樓機關密佈,又廣招花蝴蝶花沖、神手大聖鄧車和小諸葛沈仲元等江湖俠士加盟,伺機造反。包公得悉襄陽王叛跡,乃命門生顏春敏前往調查。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富商之子平建人由於不願繼承父業,決定跟女朋友蘇詠蘭自開旅行社,招攬女教師董嫻芸和四個少女學生遊覽馬來西亞。詠蘭在旅途中眼看女學生李愛蓉癡戀建人,又誤會建人與嫻芸相戀,傷心失望離去。後來發現嫻芸早有情人梁茂夫,一場誤會始告冰釋。愛蓉得悉建人將與詠蘭結婚,精神失常,駕車撞山受傷昏迷……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片是少林三部作的第三部。劉家輝仍飾演三德和尚,為要保護自持功夫了得便與大清高手結怨的少年英雄方世玉,差點也令少林寺陷入險境。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正德皇帝江南遇李鳳,兩人互生情愫。臨別前正德聲言回京後會立即迎娶李鳳。一年後,當他派人接李鳳回宮時,她已病重,無法承受長途跋涉。雖然最終及時趕到,卻在心愛之人的懷裡離世……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 博士的助手偷去藏有新研發原子爐秘密的微型底片,賣給犯罪集團。不料,途中卻意外地落入一名夜總會舞女和一名扒手的手中。犯罪集團為取回底片,與二人展開連場追逐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A professor’s assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 抗日戰爭期間,少年孤女唐琪愛上青年張醒亞。家庭的壓力與戰爭的動盪令這對有情人飽受煎熬。直至唐琪不幸被強姦,不容於家庭, 而唯有走上夜總會歌女的不歸路...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war.  When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘇燦是酒莊老闆的長子,生性瀟灑不羈,在被學校開除後,被迫接受家中安排的私人教師指導。沒想到這位教師竟是一位身懷絕技的武術大師,蘇燦因此拜入其門下,展開嚴格的修煉。然而,當家人與師父慘遭冷血悍匪「蜈蚣」殺害後,蘇燦踏上了一場生死難料的復仇之路。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蘭嶼紅蟲為患,島上人只信大頭目及巫醫巴達兩人。年青醫生何維德到蘭嶼找尋曾到此研究紅蟲而失蹤的父親,因而與未婚妻白丹娜鬧翻。後來何與孤女雅蘭相愛,惹來西呼達嫉妒;同時何為島民治病,令巴達信眾日減,西呼達、巴達均伺機殺何,何身陷險境而不自知……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 十八年前,胡斐之父胡一刀,與苗人鳳交換刀劍比武,被己刀傷,繼而身亡,原來胡之刀早被田歸農塗上毒藥;苗妻南蘭被田勾引,竟拋夫棄女,后田更以毒粉弄瞎苗雙眼;斐見苗受此遭遇,決定代其向藥王求救,亦因此碰上一生中最愛的藥王傳人程靈素……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men’s help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

epg.programme_title_en: The Dream of the Red Chamber
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 根據中國古典文學巨著紅樓夢改編。賈寶玉出身京城中的名門望族賈府,與表妹林黛玉彼此相戀。可惜他們的戀情為賈母所不容,更使計瞞騙寶玉另娶一富家女,結果令寶玉和黛玉這對金童玉女落入悲慘的下場。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述女俠俞飛霞,被武林盟主誤會她是运用「黑沙掌」,偷去神功寶書的幪面少女。於是她女扮男裝,混入少林寺暗中查探真相...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 陳詠薇的父母準備離異,於是把她送到章家暫住。章家長子凌霄、次子凌風、三女凌雲和年輕畫家余亞南都對詠薇很好,使她在章家農場度過了難忘的暑假。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang’s. On the Chang’s farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 為「功夫大導」劉家良於1983年自編自導自演的作品。故事描述,劉代師傅主持國術會,一向平安無事,適逢會館搬遷,劉派女兒惠英紅接掌;新舊派作風回異,劉只得離去;後因惠頻惹是非,劉聞訊即回巢聲援…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighbourhood.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年政局腐敗,社會民不聊生,慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔,以及保護人民的能力,反而迷信以吞符唸咒,自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人,決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京,慈禧太后倉惶逃難;人民這才醒悟到,只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動,才是挽救中國的唯一希望。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers’ claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝末年政局腐敗,社會民不聊生,慈禧太后與一群愚昧無知的權貴大臣不但毫無抵禦外國列強侵佔,以及保護人民的能力,反而迷信以吞符唸咒,自稱無堅不摧的「義和團」可以抵禦洋人,決意向列強宣戰。結果導致八國聯軍攻陷北京,慈禧太后倉惶逃難;人民這才醒悟到,只有孫中山先生領導的革命运動,才是挽救中國的唯一希望。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers’ claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武功高強的遊俠兒遊戲人間,劫富濟貧,往往連自已的銀子都散給災民。一日,他遇上一班強盜,打算搶劫一個正在保運一批價值連城珍寶的護衛。最初遊被他們欺騙一起劫鏢,但他在發覺後誓要進行報復。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 改編自著名中國神話《封神演義》中的章節,故事講述三千年前哪吒為救父母而犧牲自己的性命,後來因元神被置於蓮花內令他復活,哪吒更獲賜兩件寶物去解救因暴帝而受苦的百姓。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事描述二次大戰日軍侵佔上海,中國海軍力量薄弱,難以跟日艦抗衡;為保存戰力,在長江布下水雷,將一艘魚雷快艇偽裝成漁船,乘夜突襲...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Chinese Navy is attempting to defend its coastline from a Japanese attack, they send their commando unit led by Cui Hsia into the mainland to enlist help to thwart the Japanese before they attack. The commandos enlist the help of Song San and Shiao Liu to kill the Japanese officers led by Shan Mao and destroy their attacking ships.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅,與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住,三女各有愛情際遇;白眉雖愛錢,卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊,兩人只好互許後會有期之願;朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師,分手後又愛上賽車手;姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫,她本最愛窮工人李吉,李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手,姚姚嫁予富家子,卻仍掛念李吉...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清朝年間,少林派以反清復明為志,武當派卻為清廷所用,兩大門派因而逐漸形成敵對局面,並掀起一場又一場的打鬥…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 威力無敵的兵器鴛鴦刀將要送給滿清的皇帝,卻不慎落入蕭中慧和袁冠南手裏。大內高手卓天雄於是出發追捕二人,誓要取回鴛鴦刀。大戰一觸即發,此刻鴛鴦刀的秘密也同被揭開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正氣凜然的劍客白一鵬向「冷血五祖」報仇,卻遭追打至殘廢。數年後,一位年青人巧遇躲在洞穴裡的白一鵬,白一鵬亦決定將追風劍法傳授給這位堅毅的年青人,以助他向「冷血五祖」復仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

epg.programme_title_en: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教,與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰,後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧,卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對,還將朝氣帶入校園,大受學生歡迎,李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿,侍機剷除陳。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls’ high school, is stuck with a baby that isn’t his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 韋風奉皇帝之命潛入田家尋找田老爺造反的證據。他因此認識了田老爺的孫女,二人更結為夫妻。韋風終於取得證據,並打算與妻子離開。田老爺得知後遂萌殺機,二人惡鬥下他的妻子慘死。韋風死裡逃生,並自創螳螂拳法,誓要為妻子報仇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian’s rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian’s granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 華南影帝張瑛與梁天合作的清末喜劇,二人分飾師爺荒唐鏡及奇人陳夢吉。陳得知荒平素極盡斂財害人之能事,遂喬扮應徵僕人...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying (whos done over 400 films) as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. Its a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because peoples lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 富家女田思思性格刁蠻任性,略通武藝。自從聽聞武林名俠秦歌﻿蓋世無雙的英勇事跡後,心生仰慕。她拒絕順從父親的婚姻安排,女扮男裝,私自出走尋找秦歌﻿,欲向他挑戰。豈料,途中卻誤入黑道陰謀的漩渦……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father’s arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge—only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王金龍與名妓蘇三相愛,無奈無錢被趕出富春院。蘇被老鴇賣予富戶沈燕林為妾,卻被沈妻誣告毒殺親夫,判以死罪。已考取功名的王,決意開堂覆審救蘇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事講述張愛珠無意得知自己是孤兒,故往找生母。生母茱莉與流氓劉老四同居,老四心起歪念,竟欲非禮愛珠,茱莉救了女兒,卻被老四誤殺。愛珠逃回養父母家,始深深體會到養父母對她的愛。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: Theres no place like home.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戴天仇自幼習武,矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人,到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕,並突遭多名幫會中人毒打,吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤,希望可乘機報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father’s death.  He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 戴天仇自幼習武,矢志為父報仇。彼時其殺父仇人,到處為非作歹。戴上路途中遇上女扮男裝的吳小燕,並突遭多名幫會中人毒打,吳遂求父允其把戴帶返家中養傷。戴竟因此得以混入仇人地盤,希望可乘機報仇...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father’s death.  He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 梁觀偕同情侶沈燕,在郊外遊玩談心時,不幸遇上歹徒劫財色,梁護花不成更慘遭毒手。梁之摯友黃國棟報仇心切,遂毅然投身警界,期有機會親自偵緝兇手。五年後,黃因出眾表現被升職之餘,亦與沈日久生情;不久,因一宗離奇的謀殺案件,沈認出當年殺害梁的兇手……
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這個故事洋溢著《羅密歐與茱麗葉》般的悲戀色彩。兩個世代積怨已深的家族,被一條遍佈鱷魚的河流阻隔,誰也不願築橋往來。然而,命運卻讓兩家子女在大學裡邂逅並深深相愛。為了相守,他們不僅必須跨越險惡的河流,更要化解兩個家族間延續多年的仇恨。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 太湖決戰前夕,白水宮主人被東瀛劍客所傷。於是,他囑咐其弟寶玉代尋找解藥。途中寶玉偶遇關外的小公主,二人一見鍾情。但原來小公主的背後卻隱藏著一個重大陰謀…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 楊國良是探長兒子,國良怪父沉迷工作,母離世仍在查案,隔膜頓生。國良遇上舞女梅琳,兩人母親皆歿,了解下迅即同居生活。國良因生活費花盡到俱樂部賭錢,被陳彪騙下巨款,更強姦梅琳。國良憤然殺死陳彪,遭警察圍捕......
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Kuo, a police’s son, blames his father for his mother’s death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 高氏五兄弟,少時家遭巨變,流離失散。長大後,各有際遇,不知殺父仇人就是無惡不作的騰龍莊主。但五兄弟各自均不滿騰龍莊欺淩弱小之所作所為,並誓要除魔。當五兄弟重逢後,他們一起努力練功,準備與騰龍莊莊主及其幫會一戰。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 的士司機阿發與少女阿霞相愛已久,但發有神經錯亂,霞為除心理負擔,忍痛分手; 發大鬧霞家並斷指示真心,令霞感動而復合。然發卻不務正業,令霞甚為反感;一次爭執間,發狂性大發,霞流產,再次離開發...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 受到《醉拳》啟發,這部功夫喜劇描述一名傻頭傻腦的功夫小子自創了一套蟋蟀拳,其後更逐一打敗曾欺凌他的武林人士。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院,終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現,改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警,最終成功不讓房東出售家園。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 女俠「金燕子」的兄長被山贼擄走,幸得武功高強的「醉俠」范大悲相助,從作惡多端的寺廟主持手上救出兄長。本片曾代表香港出戰第39屆奧斯卡金像獎最佳外語片的首輪評選。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong’s entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹,再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導
epg.episode_synopsis_en: This joyous, raucous,  colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 通天少爺李寶通乃棉胎店老闆李昌建之獨子,平素不服父親管教外,還經常整蠱作怪;古板嚴謹的李昌建,屢遭兒子作弄亦不自知。寶通經常暗中替喬裝乞丐的偵緝隊長陳英剛買食物,並向他學習武功;後英剛給「紅槍客」林飛殺死,寶通正好在暗處看見事發經過,並偷聽到林飛所透露的犯案者名字。此時,寶通行蹤被發現,幸寶通機智,得以逃脫,惟其胸部上的蒼鷹刺青已被林飛看到…
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao’s chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 明朝時代,書生田玉川因替漁夫伸張正義,誤殺總督之子,被迫逃亡。走投無路時,他逃至江畔,幸得漁夫之女相救。二人在險境中情愫暗生,玉川遂以傳家至寶「蝴蝶盃」為信物,締結終身之約。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman’s honour but accidentally kills the governor’s son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river’s edge, he is rescued by the fisherman’s daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執到寶為武功了得的尋寶專家,因聞招九積自稱有張保仔寶藏之線索,乃往賭場將其救出;招云古董商人魯古董藏有張生前一批信札,執、招夜竊不遂,以敲碎古玩要脅,取得信札;惟信札字跡陳舊,僅認清法華寺字樣;彼時適逢高僧無相下山,執遂假扮瘋僧約無相談禪,招則暗闖其房搜尋秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and it left no doubt that he had made a full recovery. Liu Chia-yung, brother of preeminent martial arts moviemaker Liu Chia-liang, was famous in his own right for kung-fu comedies, and he out-did himself with this one. Imagine Bob Hope and Bing Crosby with the skills of Jet Li and Jackie Chan, and you’ve got an idea of the fun and fury inherent in this delightful tale of two con men vying for a horde of hidden gold. Add to the mix a Shaolin monk (played by Master Killer Gordon Liu Chia-hui), a powerfully brutal villain, and his equally dangerous mute sister (future director Yang Tsing-tsing), and you’ve got one of the most internationally loved kung-fu capers ever made.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 執到寶為武功了得的尋寶專家,因聞招九積自稱有張保仔寶藏之線索,乃往賭場將其救出;招云古董商人魯古董藏有張生前一批信札,執、招夜竊不遂,以敲碎古玩要脅,取得信札;惟信札字跡陳舊,僅認清法華寺字樣;彼時適逢高僧無相下山,執遂假扮瘋僧約無相談禪,招則暗闖其房搜尋秘密...
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Fans of the international star Alexander Fu Sheng were aghast. Their idol had broken both his legs and was recuperating. Everyone wondered: would he be able to return to the action comedies for which he was so famous? This movie was the answer, and i

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 本片由三個單元故事組成,為岳楓、程剛及張徹聯合執導,當年就有「花一張票價,看三套電影」的稱譽。嶽楓之〈鐵弓緣〉講述一對青年男女因一把鐵弓而結緣、程剛之〈胭脂虎〉講述一群絕色妓女的故事、張徹之〈白水灘〉講述梁山英雄後代的故事。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not be

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 這部音樂喜劇講述青年貝小芬與好友漢堡飽在廣告界內尋找真愛和成就的故事。

epg.episode_synopsis_en: In postwar Japan, Godzilla brings new devastation to an already scorched landscape. With no military intervention or government help in sight, the survivors must join together in the face of despair and fight back against an unrelenting horror.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《戰艦世紀》中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋、天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥。由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜、泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In Battleship, Earth battles a powerful alien force across sea, sky, and land. Directed by Peter Berg and starring Liam Neeson, Taylor Kitsch, and Rihanna, its explosive action at sea.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 克里斯和女友羅斯在她家的莊園共度週末。起初,熱情的歡迎似乎讓他們對跨種族關係感到尷尬——直到令人不安的真相浮出水面。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Chris joins his girlfriend Rose for a weekend at her family’s estate. At first, their warm welcome seems like awkwardness about their interracial relationship—until disturbing truths emerge.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在贏得第74屆飢餓遊戲後,凱妮絲·艾佛丁(Katniss Everdeen)平安返鄉。然而,她逐漸察覺反抗的火種正在暗中燃起,而都城依然牢牢掌控著帕納姆。隨著新一屆飢餓遊戲的籌備進行,一場足以永遠改變帕納姆命運的風暴即將展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Katniss Everdeen has returned home safe after winning the 74th Annual Hunger Games. She senses that a rebellion is simmering, but the Capitol is still very much in control as the next Hunger Games is prepared—a competition that could change Panem for

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傑瑞德・巴特勒與尼可拉・科斯特-瓦爾道主演,化身彼此對立的諸神,展開一場決定宇宙命運的史詩對決,震撼人心的奇幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Gerard Butler and Nikolaj Coster-Waldau star as rival gods locked in an epic battle to decide the fate of the universe in this thrilling fantasy-adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場巨大地震引發連鎖反應,威脅著全球兩座最大型核反應爐。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A massive earthquake creates a chain of events that threaten two of the largest nuclear reactors.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一場巨大地震引發連鎖反應,威脅著全球兩座最大型核反應爐。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 2084年,建築工人道格拉斯·奎德前往雷卡爾星球,進行一次虛擬的火星之旅——但這趟旅程卻意外喚醒被封存的記憶,將他捲入一場致命叛亂與特工身份的過去。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In 2084, construction worker Douglas Quaid visits Rekall for a virtual Mars vacation—but the procedure unlocks hidden memories, thrusting him into a deadly rebellion and a secret-agent past.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 昆汀・塔倫提諾第八部作品,背景設定於寒冷的懷俄明州,八名陌生人——包括兩名賞金獵人與一名通緝犯——在暴風雪中被迫聚在一起,對抗天候,也彼此對立。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Quentin Tarantino’s 8th film takes place in wintry Wyoming, where eight strangers, including two bounty hunters and a wanted fugitive, find themselves battling the elements and each other.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《戰艦世紀》中,地球與強大的外星勢力展開一場橫跨海洋、天空與陸地的激烈戰鬥。由彼得·柏格執導,連恩尼遜、泰勒克奇與蕾哈娜領銜主演,呈現震撼爆炸級的海上動作鉅片。

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 施惠國的每個地區在一年一度的飢餓遊戲比賽都必須送出一男一女決一死戰。珍妮花羅倫絲飾演16歲的凱妮絲艾弗丁,她自願代替妹妹參加比賽。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Every district in the nation of Panem must send a boy and girl to fight to the death in the annual Hunger Games competition. Jennifer Lawrence is 16-year-old Katniss Everdeen, who volunteers to take her younger sister’s place in the games.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在《遺落戰境》中,湯姆・克魯斯飾演一名在未來地球踏上救贖之旅的男子。由《創:光速戰記》導演執導,這是一部視覺震撼、直面過去以拯救人類的科幻冒險。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In *Oblivion*, Tom Cruise stars as a man on a journey of redemption in a future Earth. Directed by the creator of *TRON: Legacy*, it’s a visually stunning sci-fi adventure about confronting the past to save humanity.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A man takes his revenge on the family responsible for his wrongful sentence to ten years of hard labor.
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A man takes his revenge on the family responsible for his wrongful sentence to ten years of hard labor.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Banana Joe lives in a tropical village in Africa which is unaffected by modern life. One day he discovers he needs a permit to operate his boat so goes off to the big city to get one. On the way he witnesses television, crooks and many delights for the first time as well as falling in love.

epg.programme_title_tc: Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart to Hades
epg.programme_title_en: Lone Wolf and Cub: Baby Cart to Hades
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: In a rare moment of compassion, Lone Wolf rescues a girl who has killed a pimp in self-defense. By his code, he is forced to endure being tortured to within an inch of his life. Lone Wolf takes to the road again, where his expertise is very much in demand, so much so that a would-be employer had already had a contract placed on him. The slayer with the baby cart proceeds down bloodstained paths to Hades.

Even with all their training, will they be able to stop the terrorists when they begin killing hostages and turning loose their squads of attack midgets?

Even with all their training, will they be able to stop the terrorists when they begin killing hostages and turning loose their squads of attack midgets?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: A professional killer, Jeff Costello, executes a nightclub owner on orders from the mob. He is caught in a police dragnet and arrested, but witnesses fail to identify him. Costello is released by the police, but remains their prime suspect. The mob, hearing of his arrest, fear being involved and order him silenced before he can talk. Using information supplied by his girlfriend, he kills the hit man sent after him. Ultimately, the police corner him in a crowed nightclub where he is killed in a bloody gun battle.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 香港警員阿山以臥底身份潛伏在監獄,接近罪犯天哥,以獲取其犯罪集團的更多證據。二人獲釋後,阿山全力幫助天哥扶搖直上,最終使天哥成為集團的主腦。然而,當阿山協助警方順利摧毀犯罪集團時,他卻意外揭開了天哥的..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: Iron Squad W 是個韓國軍事求生真人秀。新一季的節目將選出最精銳的女軍人。節目匯聚了六個特種部隊單位,在陸地、海洋和空中執行極具挑戰性的任務。每隊特種部隊都有4名最精銳的預備役女軍人參加比賽..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 緝毒隊成員泰樺、老米、阿峰和阿棠共同參與抓捕毒梟的行動。然而,因黑警洩密,阿峰遇難,上司犧牲,阿棠也隨之消失。為了揭開真相,泰樺與老米在剿滅毒梟的過程中,必須在忠誠與背叛之間掙扎。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Narcotics squad members—Tai Hua, Lao Mi, Ah Feng, and Ah Tang—are involved in arresting a drug lord. However, a betrayal within the police leads to the deaths of Ah Feng and his superior, while Ah Tang vanishes. As Tai Hua and Lao Mi uncover the truth, they find themselves torn between loyalty and betrayal in their fight against the drug cartel.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 赤練君在押解過程中逃脫,張道長亦因此被逐出師門。為追查赤煉君的下落,張道長來到一個地方,發現有很多平民無故失蹤。當張道長查出赤練君為練成蛇魔而抓走平民後,一場人魔大戰旋即展開。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

Despite an anarchist attack, the team strives to overcome the fierce battle so that the supplies can be delivered to the villagers successfully.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印,放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山,與其大打出手,不幸身形被滅,要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困,天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘,他得要感動三..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Pu Song Ling accidentally releases the Black Mountain Demon during his writing. A goddess fights the demon but her body is destroyed, leaving behind her spirit. She borrows the body of Pus wife to continue the fight but they get trapped by the Black Mountain Demon. To save his wife, Pu must touch another three demons heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一列載著淘金夢開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難,卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊,而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出,在村中大開殺戒。吳天等..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A train carrying gold rushers derails and falls off the cliff. Wu and other passengers survive, but are attacked by centipedes. Subsequently, they escape to a village. With the village head trying to kill them and the centipedes attacking at the same time, can Wu and other passengers escape the disaster? What is the secret of the village head?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊,毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地,尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層,他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時,便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖,在一番激戰後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: u sets out to find the Godly Flame and save the dying Nan. On his way, he encounters Master Shi of Can Yan Sect when vanquishing a guardian beast. Fu and Shi battle for their respective halves of the treasure map but eventually reconciled after a fierce fight. Both decide to share the map and team up to search for the treasure and the Godly Flame.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 黃河邊的一個小村落,有一口浮棺出現後,村中怪事頻發。撈屍人趙家帶人下水查探,但只有家主一人生還。多年後浮棺再現,千年巨蛇亦浮出水面,趙家後代趙佰用祖傳秘術來對付巨蛇。另外陳家因盜墓受到詛咒,壽命很短,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A floating coffin triggers a series of disasters in the village and only a member of the Zhao family survives. Years later, the coffin reappears with a serpent and a Young Zhao vows to kill it. Meanwhile, the Chen family is cursed and it can only be broken by the floating coffin. This results in the two families teaming up in a dangerous adventure.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 老實刻板的理髮師杜常勇喪妻後獨自撫養女兒。他想女兒能繼承自己的理髮店,但女兒一心只想參加新秀比賽節目當明星。二人缺乏理解加上代溝,引發父女之間頻繁爭吵。在一次爭吵後,杜到天台勸女兒回家,父女兩突然被宇..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Honest hairstylist Du Chang Rong, raises his daughter on his own and hopes that she will take over his salon. However his daughter dreams of becoming an artiste. In a fight between Du and his daughter on the roof, they accidentally got struck by lightning and discover that they have swapped identities after regaining consciousness!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人,團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛,公司主要是保護客戶安全,俗稱“保鏢。這天,他們接到一個匿名委託,要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸,之後逸便頻生意外。童發現..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Handicapped Tong is the founder of a security company. His team includes mechanical expert An Ning and martial arts expert Da Niu. One day, they receive an anonymous order to protect An Nings sister, who since then has frequent accidents. While Tong unveils an organization specializing in accidental homicide, who wants to kill An Nings sister?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天晟初年,林堅在“彩戲師紅衣的幫助下蕩平九州。數年後,林堅久病臥床,二皇子林廣密謀篡位。林廣又收買了紅衣心腹周方為自己所用。項羽後人項白與好友彩英,機緣巧合下加入了紅衣的雲機社。隅然周方發現彩英與紅..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Jian, who rules China with the aid of sorcerer Hong Yi, is ill. His brother bribes Hong Yis confidant, Zhou Fang, in an attempt to seize the throne. Xiang Bai and Cai Ying fortuitously join Hong Yis club, and when Zhou Fang discovers the resemblance between Hong Yi and Cai Ying, she kidnaps Cai Ying in a conspiracy to fake Hong Yi.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀,尤如白天,然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩,更流傳著“點燈殺人的傳說,以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後,發現了很多反常之處,後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追,倆人為了還百姓一個太平安..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lanterns once illuminated Fu Feng City at night, but it is now shrouded in darkness as there is a rumor that people will get killed when their lights are on. When Wen Ning discovers anomalies in this situation, he joins forces with Nan Si Zhui to find the real culprit behind and finally restore peace and harmony to the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 國際刑警鐵嘉文痛失愛人後隱姓埋名成為了健身房老闆娘。她帶領著男神教練孟京、瑜伽教練喜喜和拳擊教練東妮,本想安然度日,然而舊日仇怨和黑勢力仍不放過鐵。一場針對鐵和其姐妹的狩獵遊戲正悄然展開,鐵決意替姐妹..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Interpol officer Tie Jia Wen mourns the loss of her lover, and lives incognito as a gym owner with her coaches, Meng Jing, Xi Xi and Dong Ni. However, Tie is troubled by her past when vengeful triad gangs come after her and her coaches. Vowing to uphold justice, Tie decides to fight against the evil gangsters.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 三國時期,一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺,青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親征為關羽報仇,任命關羽之子關興組成小隊,秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻,最終與殺父仇人..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: General Pan Zhang of the Wus killed General Guan Yu and took away his Green Dragon Crescent Blade. Two years later, Emperor Liu Bei brings an army led by Guan Xing, the son of Guan Yu, to attack Wus waterfront defence. Guan Xing overcomes all challenges and fights against General Pan Zhang to avenge his fathers death, and reclaims the blade.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 一對綁匪誤將刑警丁偉女友,蘇雅婷綁架。本來是一場精心設計的綁架事件,卻陰差陽錯鬧出驚天命案。丁偉錯失摯愛,決心抓住兇手,千里追兇。
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Detective Ding Weis girlfriend, Su Ya Ting, is mistakenly kidnapped. The plot takes a dark turn when she is brutally murdered. Devastated by the loss, Ding dedicates himself to the task of capturing the murderer, putting in relentless efforts to seek justice for his beloved.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪,皇帝突死於怪病,在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太后請求悔婚遭拒絕,漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和,公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持,白奕在混戰中救出..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Demon cult prevails in the Yun Sheng dynasty. The Emperor arranges the princess to marry General Bai Yi before he dies, but the princess wants to end her engagement. When the princess eventually falls for Bai, she is kidnapped by the demon cult and Bai is killed in a fight while trying to save her. Will the couple be separated forever?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 靈蛇山白蛇與青蛇姊妹潛心修煉,某日白蛇遇險,幸得上山尋藥的許仙搭救,兩人之後一心相戀。然而人妖殊途,許仙被迫離開白蛇。陰司大妖王下令追捕白蛇。白蛇生命垂危卻將千年修行給了許仙,許仙自取心臟救回白蛇後自..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: White Snake and Green Snake devote themselves to attain immortality in a mountain. Xu Xian save White Snake one day and they fall in love. With demons and the underworld against them, both lovers sacrifice themselves to save the other. A hundred years later, White Snake give up on becoming an immortal and returned to the mortal world to find Xu.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,自稱是捉鬼大師的豪哥和他的兩個徒弟雖然有點真功夫,卻多數靠小聰明以詐騙為生。直至鎮上真的發生了離奇事件,他們終能發揮所長,憑藉自身的聰明才智和高強武功,遂一破解小鎮殭屍作亂玄案,並一併剷除鎮..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A self-declared ghost buster Hao, and his two disciples, possess good skills but resort to fraud ghost hunting skills to make money. When mysterious incidents happen in town, they can finally unleash their skills to solve the mystery of the vampire case and exterminate the evil sects by using their wits and martial arts skills.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大荒城城主張塢為復活三千年前被皇帝打敗而封印於東海某處的赤睺,到處蠱惑人心,並指使各種妖怪在人間胡作非為。少年李靖學成下山後見此情景,堅信心中正義一路斬妖除魔,並與路途中遇到的薑子牙等人結為隊友,各顯..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Master of Da Huang City orchestrates demonic chaos on earth to revive Chi Hou, who was sealed by the Emperor three thousand years ago. After his martial arts training, Li Jing vows to vanquish the demons and uphold justice. Together with Jiang Zi Ya and team, he strives to save the people in a deadly battle against the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 正邪之首,龍門及異門在昆侖之巔決戰,異門被滅,龍門首領朗炎建立龍都城,並設立龍雀衛組織。轉眼十二年後,突然朗遭蜘蛛人襲擊中毒,龍雀衛首領方圓及聖女姬心在調查襲擊事件的過程中,發現異門後人利用噬魂蜘蛛企..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Leaders of Long Sect and Yi Sect battled and the Yi Sect was defeated. 12 years later, Lang Yan, Long Sects leader, is poisoned by the spider demon. As Longs guard and Ji Xin investigate the case, they uncover a plot by Yis descendants to unleash spider demons onto Long to create chaos. The battle between good and evil will soon begin....

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國女學生林家英親眼目睹姐姐被軍閥馬世傑迫害致死而卻無能為力,並在隨後趕到的何美梓口中得知姐姐原來是秘密特工隊“魅影的一員。為替姐姐報仇,英加入魅影特工隊,接受訓練成為一名美豔特工。在一次執行任務中..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young student Ying helplessly witness her sister being persecuted to death by a warlord. When she realizes her sister is a member of the secret agency Phantom, Ying vows to avenge her death and joins Phantom. She eventually becomes a pretty secret agent but soon unveils the secret behind Phantom during a mission.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,一顆外太空隕石載著三顆晶瑩玉石墜落人間一村莊,傳聞任何人進入此村莊的森林都會遇到山鬼,而從沒人能成功走出來。二十年後傳說中的山鬼又再次出現,而且引發了多宗血案。當案件被深入調查時,原本被掩蓋..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Two decades ago, a meteorite carrying three crystals struck a village on Earth. Rumor has it that anyone entering the village forest will be haunted by a mountain ghost and trapped. After 20 years, the ghost reappears, causing a series of murders. As investigation begins, the hidden truth behind the mystery is gradually uncovered.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後,因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服,在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下,逐漸找回自我與理想,再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰,最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍,成..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After hiding in Mount Zhang for seven years,  Zhao Zi Long reunites with Liu Bei and Zhao Yun. Persuaded by Lius righteousness, Zhao rediscovers his aspirations and rallies his comrades to battle their enemies at Chang Ban Slope. He eventually defeats the enemies and emerges as the Great General of the Han Dynasty.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 漁民子豪生活在海邊小鎮歸港,以捕魚為生。有一天,他偶然遇到一位神秘的女孩小藝,兩人互生情愫,終於走在一起。但好景不長,突然有一個名叫老金的神秘中年人到來,揭開了小藝真實的身份竟然是人魚族!子豪能否接受..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fisherman Zi Hao lives in a small seaside town and earns a living on the water. One day, he finds himself enchanted by a mysterious woman Xiao Yi, and they fall in love.  However, a strange man appears and uncovers the true identity of Xiao Yi as a mermaid one day.  Can Zi Hao face the truth and can Xiao Yi keep the secret of the mermaid tribe?

epg.programme_title_en: Monkey King: The One and Only
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 孫悟空在西天取經的路上,總是被師父唐僧質疑胡亂殺生,因此導致師徒之間產生隔閡。有一天,他們遇到了狐貍小七,而小七哥哥為了延續小七的性命,便起了要吃唐僧肉來救小七的念頭。哥哥開始用詭計動搖他們的信念,令..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Monkey King clashes with Monk Tang on their quest for Buddhist Sutras as Tang suspects Monkey of taking lives. One day, they meet Foxy Seven, whose brother plans to eat Monk Tang to save his life. Foxy Sevens brother stirs up conflicts between Monk and Monkey, but through trials and tribulations, they reconcile and continue their journey.

epg.programme_title_en: The Legend and Hag of Shaolin
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 清康熙年間,少林弟子洪熙官為完成師父蔡九儀遺志,與師弟方世玉前往廣州發揚少林武學。洪熙觀在與吳三桂勢力,朝廷勢力,廣東拳師等不同的人交手過程中,逐漸將戚家軍功夫、少林功夫、和明末廣東地方拳術融為一體,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Shaolin disciple Hong Xi Guan travels to Guangzhou with Fang Shi Yu to propagate Shaolin martial arts. Through exchanges with rival sect masters and imperial forces, Hong integrates Shaolin martial arts skills into other martial arts styles and established the Hung Sect, which embodied the collective wisdom and beauty of the martial arts world.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港,處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代,警方與黑社會勾結,窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店老闆娘鐵姐,帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力,保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫,並與..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the 1970s, Hong Kong was in a dark age under British colonization. The police collude with the triads and make the poor suffer. A restauranteur leads her staff to fight against the triads and protect the weak. They team up with the residents to combat the triads and fight against the corrupted police, finally restoring peace and harmony.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 以阿古力為首的狼衛軍攻打硫勒城,企圖得到竊天氏的龍脈寶藏和天下第一美人將軍史天驕。守城將軍史萬夫寡不敵眾,與好友肖不平密謀,利用《竊天書》設計反攻狼衛軍。史為了擊退狼衛軍,拯救自己的女兒和全城百姓,竟..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Wolf Guard Army invades the city to seize the treasure of Qie Tian Clan and to capture a beautiful female general. Though largely outnumbered, General Shi and his friend Shao plot to counterattack the Wolf Guard Army. To rescue his daughter and the people, Shi decapitates himself continues to battle the enemies as a headless general.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 童松因為一場車禍失去雙腿,不過他擁有著超高智商,並與擅長電腦科技的安寧及身手不凡的大牛合夥開辦保鏢公司。公司接到的第一單是保護寵物狗的任務,看似平常,但在委托的過程中實則危機四伏,麻煩不斷,更發現背後..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tong Song is a genius but unfortunately lost his limbs in a car accident. He sets up a security services company with a computer expert and a skilful fighter, and their first job is to protect a dog. The job seems quite simple, but it turns out to be a perilous task as they unravel a conspiracy behind the mission.

epg.programme_title_en: Sword Dynasty: The Treasure of Sword
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 巴山劍場被滅門後僥倖逃過一劫的夜策冷,迫於無奈假意歸順蘅王留在他身邊,伺機殺掉他為師傅報仇。江湖傳聞孤山劍藏在雲來鎮,蘅王派陳玄及夜策冷前往調查,而鎮上突然傳有血妖出沒。在調查途中,夜意外救了假扮捉妖..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The sole survivor from a massacre, Ye pretends to be subservient to Emperor Heng and awaits a chance to avenge his masters death. Ye and Chen are assigned to investigate a case of a blood demon. In the process, Ye accidentally rescues Ji Zhen who poses as a monster hunter. With the help of Ji Zhen, Ye unravels the truth about the blood demon.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 故事圍繞著一檔真人冒險節目展開,幾位不同背景的陌生人聚集在鱷夢島上。據說這個海島不僅景色宜人,還藏著一枚價值連城的金蛋,參加者要共同完成島上的冒險以嬴取最終大獎。然而,他們卻都在懵懂中成了犧牲品,因為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A reality adventure show takes place on Crocodile Island, where participants from diverse backgrounds compete for a priceless golden egg. They must team up to complete the adventures on the island and win the grand prize. Unknowingly though, they become the victims of a complicated and evil plan.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 安史之亂平定之後,安史餘孽成立了飛乙幫,秘密遊走於藩鎮之間,企圖重新挑起戰禍,計劃起兵於河北。為了清剿飛乙賊子,朝廷命劍聖裴旻公招募了一些江湖上的劍俠,成立了長水門。貞元十二年,飛乙幫和長水門各自在魏..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After the An Shi Rebellion, the An Shi rebels unite as Fei Yi Gang to attack Hebei. Meanwhile, the court appoints swordsmen of the martial arts world to form Chang Shui Gang to eliminate the rebels. Both gangs set up traps in Wei Bo and a deadly battle has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 南宋末年,國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教,妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖,危難之際,無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出,協助朝廷擊退敵軍,卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗,死傷慘重。為了振興門派,保衛家園,張毅然..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Tribe Di join forces with the Demon Cult to rule the martial arts world. Zhang San Feng, a disciple of Wu Ji Clan, helps the government to fight the rebels but this results in his clan suffering heavy casualties. To save his clan and his homeland, Zhang sets out to destroy the Demon Cult but gets entangled in another conspiracy in the process.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1990年的東北,年輕氣盛的私營小巴司機徐鐵愛上了家境優渥的陳麗莎,因為現實差距,二人的關係遭到麗莎的母親反對。為了賺錢,徐鐵誤入歧途,導致了身邊人的犧牲。在家人和朋友的幫助下,徐鐵終浪子回頭,明白了..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young minibus driver Xu Tie falls for a rich girl Lisa. However, Lisas mother disapproves of Xu due to their social differences. Xu Tie goes astray in the hope of earning more money, but ends up harming his friends. With the support of family and friends, Xu Tie tries to make amends and begins to appreciate love and life.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 二十年前,大巫祭率領暗黑一族侵襲人族,戰神張赤炎不惜犧牲自己喚醒戰神劍,才得以擊退暗黑族。如今黑暗力量再次蘇醒,蠢蠢欲動,戰神之子張珂與及雲柃、福喜再次踏上喚醒戰神劍的旅程,而張珂也在戰鬥中成長為新戰..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: 20 years ago, God of War Zhang Chi Yan sacrificed himself to restore the power of his sword so as to defeat the Tribe of Darkness. As the tribe becomes active again, Zhangs son, Ke, and his friends set out to restore the swords power. Zhang Ke is now the new God of War with the sword, leading his people to fight a deadly battle with the demons.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國年間,發丘一脈的傳人張聞風為了尋找父親失蹤真相,及阻止境外惡勢力盜取不死神樹,與夥伴踏上兇險萬分的古墓之旅,但他們卻誤闖誤撞進入了崑崙山,一個藏有 百神 的上古神跡崑崙墟。然而令張意想不到的是..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Zheng Min Feng embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to an ancient tomb to find his missing father and protect the immortal tree. However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

However, they mistakenly go to Mount Kwun Lun, the sacred site with One Hundred Gods. Amidst the creepy legend and perilous journey, they must confront the enigmatic depths of the human heart.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件,排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和周密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患,守護群眾安全,特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前,不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: After a sudden explosion in the city, the anti-explosion team dashes to the scene to rescue and investigate. Led by Officer Ma and Officer Zhu, they prioritize peoples safety and set out to prevent further explosions. Tension mounts as the situation becomes increasingly volatile. Can the team defeat the odds and bring an end to the crisis?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期,用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立,以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及征戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞,三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: In the Republican period, many sects use sleazy scams to deceive the public. Young maiden Sun Jin, armed escort Li, and the kung fu expert Yang, join forces to uncover the truth behind the widespread deception. However, they soon discover the hidden secrets of Yang and Li. Who amongst them is the true villain?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 亂世末期,商朝遭到周武王的進攻,被周軍將領楊戩打得節節敗退。軍師申公豹向紂王建議招攬梅山七怪助商攻周,因為七怪之首袁洪與楊戩一樣精通八九玄功可七十二變。紂王命申公豹立刻前往梅山將七怪納入麾下。於是,楊..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Emperor Zhou Wu has defeated the Shang empire with General Yang defeating the Shang army. Military advisor Shen advises Emperor Shang to recruit Seven Monsters with mystic skills to attack Zhou, so Emperor Shang orders his general to find Seven Monsters in Mountain Mei. The battle between Zhou and Shang has just begun!

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 歡宜寨突然怪病橫行,為了救寨,守山人長生前去尋找傳說中的九色鹿王。另外,大月國王宮內已被妖後控制,太子延頤為了阻止妖後,也踏上尋找九色鹿王的道路。長和延二人在途中要不斷躲避妖後的追殺,幸好有小藜等人幫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Huan Yi Village is hit by a strange disease while the Demon Queen controls the Palace, so Chang and Prince Yan are forced to seek out the legendary Nine-colour Deer King to save the people and stop the Demon Queen. Evading the Queens pursuit, they uncover the Deer Kings secret with their allies, restoring peace to the village and the kingdom.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 1996年之前的香港,雪麗在自己的婚禮現場遭遇劫匪挾持,並目睹丈夫死於匪徒槍下。雪現於一家射箭館任職,在颱風之夜意外滯留大樓內,並目擊當年同一幫匪徒在大廈內殺人。在逃亡過程中,她遇到了同為滯留者的盲眼..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During her wedding in 1996, Xue Li is taken hostage by gangsters and saw her husband being killed. One night in a typhoon, Xue Li is forced to stay at her workplace in a building, where she witnesses another murder by the same group of gangsters. As she tries to escape, she meets a blind old man and they must fight for survival together.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物,於是派出探索小隊前往調查,但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅,剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離,過程非常危險,幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸,居民被迫在地底生活..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: The Institute of Biology assigns a team to investigate the mutants in a desert, but the whole team is nearly wiped out. Luckily, two researchers escape with the mutants samples. As the residents in the desert are forced to live underground to avoid threats by the mutants, the team must beat the mutants for survival.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國初年,水派幻術師裴靜之為搶奪法寶大開殺戒,最終被火派幻術師空空封印,之後空空帶著一孤兒卓非凡離開。二十年後,裴解開封印想再次奪寶,將空空殺害。空空死前將自己撫養的卓託付給落霞飛學習火術。卓發誓要為..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Illusionist Pei of the Water Cult is trapped by Kong in a seal as he tries to kill to find the treasure. Kong leaves with an orphan Fang and 20 years later, Pei unseals himself to find the treasure again and kills Kong. As Fang learns the Fire skills from his master Kong, he vows to avenge his death but then discovers his ties to the Water Cult.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大唐盛世時期,曲江池天降妖龍異象,導致長安百姓一夜禿頭,令聖人勃然大怒。黃河縣令王玄秘密調查此案,發現背後竟有人密謀屠城計畫,影響到聖人安危。王玄深入偵查龍王教,過程中破解了金鯉迷局,更識破了屠城計畫..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Set in the Tang dynasty, a fallen demon dragon causes the people of Qujiang City to mysteriously go bald overnight. Outraged, the Emperor assigns Magistrate Wang to investigate the case. Wang infiltrates the secret Long Wang Cult and exposes their plot to instigate a massacre, eventually saving the emperor and protecting the people.

epg.programme_title_en: The Thousand Faces of Fei Jia
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 王小俠本是一個胸無大志,在市井街頭討生活的小鎮青年,與父親老瞎子生活在十隱鎮,唯一的願望就是能治好父親的眼疾。一次偶然令王小俠邂逅了沈藍兒,並意外地捲入了一場陰謀之中。而王小俠為了找能治好父親的眼疾方..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A young man Wang Xiao Xia resides in a small town with his blind father. His only desire is to cure his fathers eye disease. One day, he encounters Shen Nan Er by chance and gets embroiled in a conspiracy. In his quest to heal his fathers eyes, he goes to the Qi Yin Sect and finally unveils his hidden identity, which was concealed by his father.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 民國員警王之章的兒子因鴉片而亡。他痛恨舊社會犯罪橫行,封建思想荼毒百姓,因此偽裝成道士潛入當地商人陳老爺家調查鴉片走私案件,期間卻遇到連環殺人事件。身為員警的王之章為了職責及為兒子報仇,誓要抓住兇手,..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Policeman Wang hates crime in the city and the feudalism that lead to his sons death by opium. Disguised as a Taoist priest, he investigates opium smuggling in a merchants home and uncovers a series of murders. Driven by duty and revenge, Wang vows to find the murderer, destroy the stored opium and restore peace in the city.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 李道師聽從師傅之命下山歷練,本以為妖邪都是殘忍惡毒,卻在路上經歷了三件事,讓他悟出一些道理。當他看到黑魚精為救她無情的丈夫犧牲自己;一對相愛的戀人為了在一起而放棄生命,共同融入畫中;刺蝟精捨身為報答乾..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Master Li believes all demons to be evil until he encounters three events - a fish demon who sacrifices herself for her heartless husband, a pair of lovers who commit suicide for love, and a hedgehog monster who sacrifices himself for his godfather. These encounters make Master Li question who is more evil, humans or demons?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨,當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害,為躲避殺手追殺,郎與峰分頭走散,但郎之後音訊全無,而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中,峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Lin Lang and Lin Feng witness their mothers murder by the drug dealer Tiger fifteen years ago. They separated in their escape and Feng becomes a narcotics police officer while Lang disappears. In an operation, Feng discovers that Tiger has also killed the mother of a drug boss, Lang. Is Lang his brother? Can Feng arrest the drug dealers?

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面,不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走,其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走,憑藉著堅強意..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: A fatal pursuit happens in a no mans land. Young Jin Yan accidentally captures the scene of a poacher attacking a cop, and the villains attack and injure him when they discover his act. As Jin tries to escape, they kidnap his sister as well. Jin and his sister must strive to escape from the villains and bring them to justice.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 武則天時期,京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件,因為死因不明,以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈,百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥,人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案,最終不僅破除了謠言,也通..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: During the era of Empress Wu, rumours about mysterious murder cases are spreading in Chang An City. The people are worried and see it as an ominous sign. Detective Di is assigned to investigate the case, and not only did he manage to unravel the mystery, he also uncovers the truth and finds the culprit.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 天真無邪的少女清澄,為了給家人報仇,被訓練成冷血殺手。數度殺人後,她決定放下怨念,在安樂寨度過平靜的餘生,也在那裡結識了樂於助人的阿邦,與他結了婚。正當清澄隱藏武功平淡過活時,江湖風雲無奈又起。為了維..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Young and innocent Qing Cheng is trained to become a ruthless killer to seek vengeance for her family. After killing many, she decides to let go of her resentment and seeks refuge in a remote village, where she meets Bang and marries him. As social upheaval erupts, Qing has to step up again to protect the village and restore peace.

epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 東南亞某國打拼的華人姜芃在妻子離世後,和女兒姜小湖相依為命。姜幫大資本家察沃工作,運送傳說是一條巨鱷古斯塔夫的關鍵貨物。一場突如其來的海嘯將他們困在了唐人街,鱷魚古斯塔夫破籠而出,瘋狂撕咬眾人。姜芃父..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: Jiang Peng lives with his daughter after his wifes death. When he is tasked with delivering a giant crocodile, a tsunami strikes and trapped him and his daughter in Chinatown. As the crocodile escapes and assaults people, Jiang and the others survive luckily but find out that the episode is not an accident but a set up...

epg.programme_title_tc: 狄仁傑探案之天煞孤鸞
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大婚當日,新娘在婚房內連殺四人,當眾否認自己是兇手後剖腹自盡。雖然新娘是最大嫌疑,但鄉民卻不約而同地認為真兇是一個身形柔弱的少女,就連少女本人也自願認罪,認為自己是“天煞孤星,命格剋親近之人。隨著狄..
epg.episode_synopsis_en: On her wedding day, a bride is discovered to have killed four people before taking her own life. However, the villagers accuse a weak girl of the crime, and she herself pleads guilty due to her belief of being a lone star. As Detective Dee investigates the case, he uncovers the truth behind the mysterious murder and unveils a deadly conspiracy.

epg.programme_title_tc: 狄仁傑探案之天煞孤鸞
epg.episode_synopsis_tc: 大婚當日,新娘在婚房內連殺四人,當眾否認自己是兇手後剖腹自盡。雖然新娘是最大嫌疑,但鄉民卻不約而同地認為真兇是一個身形柔弱的少女,就連少女本人也自願認罪,認為自己是“天煞孤星,命格剋親近之人。隨著狄..
